headline: Quarterly revenue growth was mixed, with a few firms posting very strong gains while the larger players slowed.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS delivered double‑digit growth supported by AI‑related revenue. Infosys and Wipro showed the weakest top‑line momentum, and Infosys also cut its FY27 growth guidance. Profit trends were uneven, with HCLTech posting a 21% jump while Infosys and Wipro saw modest or declining profit growth.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure on large integrators
themes.detail: Despite revenue growth, Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance and Wipro signalled flat profit, indicating margin constraints.

themes.title: Strong mid‑tier growth
themes.detail: Mid‑size players such as Coforge, LTM and Tech Mahindra posted 13‑54% YoY revenue growth, outpacing the larger peers.
